title: Task write is still pending when the checkpoint advances.

steps.label: Trial 1: start graph and reach the controlled cut

verification.summary: Observed the controlled exit 73 at the intended write-pending checkpoint cut.

steps.label: Trial 1: read checkpoint and pending task writes

verification.summary: Separate read-only inspection found checkpoint sequence 1 and 0 pending task writes.

steps.label: Trial 1: resume this thread in a fresh process

verification.summary: The resumed graph returned normally and reported no pending next node.
The negative case reproduced as designed: 2 committed effects for logical sequence 1. The exactly-one-effect check correctly blocks this run.
